news.title: AI安全风险会拖累该行业的IPO前景吗？
news.snippet: AI智能体安全事件频发，投资者担忧风险因素可能削弱AI企业IPO吸引力与估值前景。
news.raw_snippet:
Andrew here. Amid a slew of headlines about A.I. agents escaping their sandboxes, Nvidia is releasing a software platform that aims to put firm guardrails around agentic software. It says the system would have prevented the recent hacking of Hugging Face by OpenAI’s models.

In related news, we have a scoop on Instinct, the hot A.I. agent start-up. This 14-person company has raised $1 billion at a $10 billion valuation from some of Silicon Valley’s biggest venture capital firms. More below. [...] ## Liability questions lie ahead

Researchers have announced a steady drumbeat of discoveries of artificial intelligence models behaving badly, pushing the topic of A.I. safety to the fore.

That raises a big question for investors in potential blockbuster I.P.O.s by Anthropic and OpenAI: How much liability could they be on the hook for?

news.raw_snippet:
# China Tech Needs AI Catalyst to Close Valuation Gap, BI Says

China’s technology stocks will need a domestic artificial intelligence catalyst to close their valuation gap with US technology peers, Bloomberg Intelligence said.

The China Tech 8 trades at a more than 50% discount to the Magnificent Seven, its widest this year, BI said. That puts pressure on Chinese tech stocks as global markets rebounded on AI momentum last week, according to the analysis.

news.title: NetApp提议收购PEAK AIO，布局AI基础设施
news.snippet: NetApp拟收购曼彻斯特初创公司PEAK AIO，旨在强化AI基础设施领域的存储与数据管理能力。
news.raw_snippet:
PEAK AIO was founded in Manchester by Mark Klarzynski and was designed to address some of the industry’s most demanding data-intensive computing challenges. The company’s core innovation, a next-generation metadata architecture and high-performance parallel file system, was developed to solve one of the defining infrastructure challenges of the AI era: enabling shared storage to scale alongside the GPU clusters that power modern AI workloads. [...] Pembroke invested in PEAK AIO in 2025 as part of its strategy of backing early-stage British technology companies with the potential to become category leaders. During its ownership, Pembroke supported the company’s funding round.

If completed, the realisation would be Pembroke’s first exit from a technology investment and Klarzynski third successful exit as a founder, underscoring the depth of entrepreneurial talent that the VCT model is designed to support. [...] AIDE (AI Deployment Engine) is an open-source enterprise orchestration platform designed for the UK National Health Service to securely integrate, execute and monitor medical AI applications within existing clinical workflows.

news.raw_snippet:
- Paid work trial. A paid 10-14 day strategic trial - real work in our real environment, taking a live product problem from intent to locked spec to verified build. If the work above reads like yours but your resume is unconventional, apply anyway. We hire on the work and the reasoning, not the pedigree. [...] case, then own the answer end to end. [...] How We Evaluate  
  
We don't run traditional product interviews.  
  
- Video screen. Brief and async - about 15 minutes, whenever works for you. It replaces the recruiter screen; answers go straight to the hiring team. We want to see how you think, not how you present.
- Calls with company stakeholders. Short conversations with key members of the team.
- Conversation with the founder. How you model systems, where you push back, and whether you can hold the product bar in a live argument.
